The provided text outlines the key facts of the Apple v. Samsung legal dispute, specifically focusing on patent infringement claims. Apple alleged that Samsung infringed on its design patents regarding smartphone aesthetics. The jury found in favor of Apple, awarding over $1 billion in damages, and determined that Samsung had copied specific design features of the iPhone, including the grid icon layout on the home screen and the rounded corners of the device.
